subject: Outdoor light fixtures follow-up
text: I have been meaning to ask about the small outdoor light fixtures you agreed to collect for me. I know you were already running late that evening, so I did not think much of it at the time, but I have been unable to use the side entrance after dark for several days now, and the temporary lamp on the porch is not holding a charge. The porch lamp is only a temporary fix, and I would rather not rely on it. When you have a moment, could you let me know whether you received the order confirmation, because I want to be sure the purchase actually cleared. If it is still sitting at the counter or at your door, there is no need to bring it over right away; I can pick it up this weekend, preferably in the morning before the weather turns. If you have not had time to check your messages yet, I understand completely, and I am happy to wait until next week. If it was already delivered to the shop and something was missing, please say so, and I will contact them directly. I appreciate your patience with this, and I do not want the unfinished task to become a lingering worry between us. Once I have the fixtures, I will bring over the garden shears you left behind last month, so we can both finish the smaller errands we each started and move on to something more pleasant than waiting.
